correctness.rationale: The correct random-plane law weights normals by width: total hit measure D/pi via the classical polyhedral edge exterior-dihedral mean-width identity. Edge-crossing projected length integral totals 2(a+b+L), proving EN=2pi(a+b+L)/D. For a generic normal, five-edge cutting-offset length is (Z-|X-Y|)_+-(Z-X-Y)_+, integrated over the positive octant to J/pi using exact spherical angle integral. Division gives p5; 3-4-5 sided support plus normalization and expectation yields p3 and p4. Differentiation yields D’=(h/L)phi and EN’ positive because D-(a+b+L)phi is a sum of strictly positive angle brackets. Limits give 2+sqrt2<EN<4; p3-p5=4-EN>0. Degenerate cuts null measure; a,b,h>0. Independently checked quadrature against unbiased spherical directions and uniform ambient offset rejection for three geometries, including nonsquare shapes; these are not continuum proofs.
